shots.visual: Forge stands left of the service trench; Ward stands right. The east lamp illuminates upper armor edges through localized oil haze; matte steel flats retain their shape.

camera.path: straight 0.5m push from the south-side platform
camera.target: the visible action and contact plane
camera.adaptation: project-specific amplitude and speed; source ID is a motion-family reference
camera.description: From the south platform, the camera slowly pushes forward half a meter, keeping both machines and the trench visible.

foley: Hydraulic pumps cycle under a steady 35 Hz motor rumble; loose floor grit clicks under the planted soles.

shots.state_description: Ward's shield and the supporting concrete slab are intact.

shots.visual: From the same safe side of the action axis, Forge brings its right forearm emitter toward Ward's raised left shield. The service doors and east-wall light retain their established positions; the trench remains between the machines.

camera.path: one-meter eastward track, easing to a hold
camera.target: the visible action and contact plane
camera.adaptation: project-specific amplitude and speed; source ID is a motion-family reference
camera.description: The camera tracks laterally one meter with the shield edge, then decelerates as the machines recover; the contact line remains unobstructed.

foley: A short metal resonance follows the visible movement.

combat.force_source: Forge loads its left sole, rotates its hip frame and drives the right shoulder forward.
combat.trajectory: The forearm follows a short forward arc toward the shield's upper outside edge.
combat.contact: The emitted stream meets the shield's beveled metal edge.
combat.resistance: Overlapping shield plates resist the impact and guide its direction downward.
combat.impact_hold: At the contact beat, the shield silhouette stays readable for two planned frames while dust continues moving.
combat.transfer: The shield retracts into Ward's shoulder damper; its rear sole slides along the floor.
combat.recoil: Forge's elbow folds back as its planted left foot absorbs the emitter's recoil.

chain.attack: Forge releases one charge toward the raised shield.
chain.response: Ward turns its hip and angles the shield to deflect the stream.
chain.result: The charge scrapes the concrete surface, leaving grit and a shallow scar without breaking the supporting slab.
chain.continuation: Ward keeps its shield forward; Forge resets its forearm with one fewer charge available.

timing.camera_sync: The camera tracks parallel to the action line, keeps the feet, weapon path and contact plane visible, and eases only after the defender's result is readable.

emissive.description: Brief orange sparks peel from the shield's contact edge and fade before reaching the doors.

vfx.lighting: The bright contact core occupies a narrow strip; soft amber spill stays local while the east-wall lamp continues to define the armor planes.

panels.description: Both units and the trench are established.

The east lamp separates the armor planes.

asset_prompt: Create one live-action mechanical confrontation frame inside the repair hangar: Forge at left with broad ochre shoulder plates and square visor, Ward at right with overlapping dark plates and silver visor, its left shield facing Forge's right forearm emitter. Preserve both eight-meter body proportions, the service trench between them, the two human-sized doors and the world-east maintenance lamp. Use a 35 mm equivalent view from the south platform with both soles and the shield contact plane visible. Painted steel stays matte across broad panels, worn shield edges show narrow metal highlights, and ceramic joints remain darker with visible thickness. The east lamp passes through localized oil haze onto the upper armor edges, with weak concrete bounce preserving the shadow-side structure. Concentrate detail at the shield bevel and actuator joints; combine distant trusses into broad quiet forms. Avoid disconnected joints, tiled micro-panels and uniform plastic gloss.
